backend/main.mo: Main backend actor handling user profiles, prompts, categories, and authorization with CRUD operations and per-user data storage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old/new actor types and a passthrough run function for data upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide outlining steps and tips for diagnosing and fixing deployment failures.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light and dark theme CSS variables and base layout rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app and linking favicon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing global UI state, authentication, backend sync, and prompt/category views.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign-in screen component prompting users to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/backend/BackendC: Displays backend connection loading or error states with messaging and a reload option.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Renders category filters, favorites toggle, and UI for renaming or deleting categories.
Allows selecting, creating, and toggling categories with input handling and a scrollable list.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming or deleting categories, showing usage counts and confirming deletions.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Provides buttons to export prompts or import them from a JSON file with backend sync.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Reusable confirmation dialog with title, description, and confirm/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Action buttons for copying, favoriting, duplicating, editing, and deleting a prompt.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Sanitizes and renders HTML prompt content safely using innerHTML.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog component for creating or editing prompts with fields for title, content, categories, and save handling.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Displays prompts in a responsive grid with categories, previewed content, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Renders prompts in a vertical list with full category display and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Modal dialog for viewing a prompt’s full title and content.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Shows prompts in a sortable table layout with preview-on-row-click and standard actions.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Search input with icon and paste-cleaning handler for filtering prompt lists.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown selector for choosing sort mode across several predefined sort options.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: UI toggle for switching between list, grid, and table prompt views.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Implements validated construction of Internet Identity logout URLs and performs full-page logout navigation with session tracking.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Provides a function that returns the fixed post-logout return URL containing an admin token hash.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: React hook coordinating reliable II logout by clearing local auth, waiting for anonymous identity, then triggering provider logout.
frontend/src/features/backend/actorDiagn: Provides functions to log structured diagnostics and configuration errors for backend connection issues.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: Defines a frontend API wrapper converting prompt and category types and performing CRUD operations via the backend actor.
frontend/src/features/backend/useBackend: React hook that tracks backend actor readiness and logs diagnostics on creation failures.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: React hook that syncs prompts and categories with the backend, performs connectivity checks, and loads data after authentication.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store for managing category names with add, rename, delete, set, and clear operations.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Hook providing a copy function with fallback support and a temporary copied state flag.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories to a downloadable JSON file with metadata.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts from a JSON file, validating structure and resolving ID collisions.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines the export data schema and validates imported prompt data.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPastedT: Cleans pasted content, preferring plain text and extracting readable text from HTML when needed.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPasteHa: Creates paste handlers for inputs and contentEditable fields that clean pasted text before insertion.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case‑insensitive search across fields.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates simple unique IDs using timestamps and random strings.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store managing prompt list with add, update, delete, duplicate, favorite toggle, and category operations.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorting utility providing various sort modes for prompts based on dates, title, and favorites.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Type definitions for Prompt objects and enums for view and sort modes.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML strings to cleaned plain text by stripping tags and collapsing whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes HTML by removing unsafe tags, normalizing color spans, and cleaning structure recursively.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: Rich text editor component supporting bold, italic, colors, paste cleaning, and contentEditable syncing.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves UI preference data, particularly viewMode, to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: React hook that auto-loads and saves viewMode to localStorage on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, identity restoration, and state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function formerly used to set favicon dynamically.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, query client, identity provider, and rendering the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from the hash. Also offers utilities to retrieve parameters with precedence for URL values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, layout, fonts, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines current project state and requirements focused on category rename and delete behavior, ensuring deletes detach items without removing them.
